content.short: The Open Network, or TON, is a decentralized Layer 1 blockchain from Telegram, with fast blocks and native Mini App distribution.
content.description: The Open Network, known as TON, is a decentralized Layer 1 blockchain first designed by Telegram and now maintained by an open source community. Its sharded architecture produces blocks in roughly half a second and keeps fees very low, which suits high volume consumer usage rather than occasional settlement. TON is best known for its distribution channel: wallets, payments, and Mini Apps embed directly inside Telegram, so applications reach a very large existing audience without asking users to install anything new or leave the chat interface.
content.meta: TON is a fast Layer 1 blockchain with native Telegram Mini App distribution. Discover The Open Network on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
